verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a drag-and-drop visual editor and code editor, Design Studio with AI-generated global styles for on-brand design, and inbox previews for checking rendering across clients. Personalization is shown through data populated into messages, and a community user found building and previewing emails intuitive. missing for 10: explicit reusable email template documentation (only an assets library for images/PDFs), concrete personalization token/Liquid syntax docs, independent corroboration that emails render correctly across clients.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Inbox preview credits are the currency for [email inbox previews in Design Studio]
When you call the API, you can include data that you want to populate in your message, like a password reset URL or the purchase data.
Building, editing and previewing emails felt straightforward and intuitive.
